verdict.rationale: Fellow provides full-transcript search, keyword tracking, and an 'Ask Fellow' Q&A feature across meetings, plus diarized/timestamped transcripts and an MCP server that lets users ask about past meetings ('What did we decide in last month's standup?'). This covers cross-meeting search and locating specific moments via timestamps, though the evidence never explicitly shows a UI screenshot of clicking a search result to jump to a video timestamp. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the jump-to-moment UI interaction, and detail on search ranking/relevance across large meeting corpora.
